title: Distribution of [1-14C] acrylonitrile in rat and monkey.
abstract: The distribution of [1-14C] acrylonitrile (ACN) in rat and monkey has been studied by whole-body autoradiography, after being administered orally and intravenously to rats and orally to monkeys. Uptake of radioactivity was seen in the blood, liver, kidney, lung, adrenal cortex and stomach mucosa.
